question: Can C01-C08 native-mesh geometry changes support a non-vacuous Teacher whose structural nodes are persistent, bidirectionally consistent, uniquely associated and detectable with past-only evidence?
method: For every C01-C08 physical edge, recompute the sealed 1 m native-mesh width/height profile independently in both directions. Reuse the frozen 5 m median comparison and 1 m width/height thresholds; retain only signal runs spanning the same 5 m scale. Pair only unique interval-overlapping reverse episodes with a shared same-signed active dimension. Independently compare two completed past-only five-sample windows, close the causal episode and back-project its boundary. Emit a label only when exactly one causal episode in each direction matches the bidirectional point. Merge within the existing 10 m radius only into degree-two endpoints; terminal/junction retain priority and ambiguous endpoints emit nothing.
baseline: The sealed old Teacher labels each direction independently using the same 5 m/1 m cross-section rule and then clusters samples by canonical arc. It does not require persistence, bidirectional agreement or causal identity qualification.
fallback: If the proof fails, preserve the old and new evidence, do not relabel or train, and reassess whether geometry should remain only a verified-edge attribute. Do not tune spans, thresholds, node radius or family quotas after observing the result.

user_authorization.scope: One immutable read-only C01-C08 causal geometry change-point proof. Zero C09/C10/M-TARE/model inference/training/optimizer steps.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: User explicitly selected A/a: retain geometry-change nodes and redefine them as persistent bidirectional causal change-points.

acceptance_criteria: Exact scope is 80 C01-C08 worlds, 8039 physical edges, 16078 directed traversals, 252430 full geometry frames and 188126 five-frame sequences.
Every emitted point has a persistent episode in both directions, exactly one past-only causal match in both directions, one deterministic identity and no observation-label collision.
Degree-two endpoint merging uses only the existing 10 m radius; terminal/junction always suppress geometry-transition and ambiguous two-endpoint cases emit nothing.
At least 500 geometry-transition observations are emitted and both C01-C06 fit and C07-C08 selection contain nonzero emitted identities.
All causal delays are finite and nonnegative; all ten families and all old-to-new identity outcomes are reported without imposing a post-result family quota.
Sources verify before and after; C09/C10/M-TARE/model inference/training/optimizer reads or steps are zero; result remains within 512 MiB and seals completely.
stop_conditions: Any source, tool, input, environment, split, count or fixed geometry scale drift.
Any non-unique bidirectional/causal match, label collision, endpoint-priority violation, nonfinite delay or insufficient non-vacuous observation support.
Any C09/C10/M-TARE/model/training access, timeout, disk overrun, retry or post-result threshold/radius/span change.
expected_evidence: Eighty world summaries; every persistent directional episode, bidirectional candidate, past-only causal episode and emitted label.
Old-to-new identity mapping, ten-family CSV, exact rejection funnel, causal delay distribution and PASS/FAIL checks.
Paper-grade PNG/PDF/SVG figure with machine-readable source and provenance; environment, command, raw log, metrics, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

estimated_cost.compute: Serial CPU/Open3D proof over existing meshes; zero GPU, sensor export, inference or training.
